<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern—a series of peaks spaced ~1.003 Da with rapidly decreasing intensities matching the natural 13C abundance—we can definitively identify carbon in the sample. No characteristic M+2 patterns for Cl, Br, or S are present, and other elements have much lower isotopic contributions. Therefore, the only element that can be definitively identified is carbon.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
